verdict.rationale: Graphite documents in-product AI analysis of the user's own code and PR data. AI reviews analyze every PR, identify issues and suggest fixes. Graphite Chat summarizes changes, highlights potential issues, diagnoses failing CI checks with full context, and offers one-click suggested fixes on the review page. A community comment confirms the AI features exist around the review UI. Missing for 10: no evidence that the Insights/productivity metrics dashboard produces AI-generated insights (it reads as plain metrics), and no independent hands-on corroboration of how useful the AI suggestions are.
